headline: Central Bank of Nigeria’s 10% foreign capital cap halts UBA’s expansion into Ethiopia
summary: United Bank for Africa, one of Nigeria's largest lenders, had planned to be the first international bank to enter Ethiopia. Its plan was halted by Nigeria's banking investment rules, according to chairman Tony Elumelu.
why: United Bank for Africa is a major pan-African lender headquartered in Lagos, and its expansion depends on cross-border banking rules. Foreign capital limits in Nigeria shape how Nigerian banks can grow across Africa.
